details: dynamoveto presents itself as a test-runner integration for Express. Mounting its middleware adds unauthenticated routes: one returns a payload URL on testingreacthooks.discloud.app (1.0.0) or testingreacthooks.discloud.dev (1.0.1), the other downloads a binary from a URL supplied by the caller, makes it executable and runs it detached. Any client that can reach the application can run a program on the server.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
